jobs.description:
Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

  • Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
  • Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
  • Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
  • Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
  • Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
  • Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.

Chez SumUp, nous aidons les commerçants du quotidien à développer leur activité grâce à des solutions de paiement et de gestion simples, accessibles et performantes.

Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. Il s'agit d'un poste 100 % terrain : vous rencontrez directement les commerçants de votre secteur, identifiez leurs besoins, leur présentez nos solutions et les accompagnez jusqu'à la signature.

Votre rémunération

Nous faisons le choix de la transparence dès le début du processus :

  • 30 000 € bruts annuels de salaire fixe
  • 27 600 € bruts annuels de variable cible, à 100 % des objectifs
  • Soit un package cible de 57 600 € bruts annuels
  • Un variable entièrement déplafonné (à titre d'exemple, les commerciaux les plus performants peuvent dépasser 100 000 € bruts de rémunération annuelle totale)

Les modalités précises du plan de commissionnement vous seront présentées pendant le processus de recrutement.

 

Vos missions

  • Prospecter directement les commerçants de votre secteur : restaurateurs, artisans, indépendants et commerces de proximité
  • Comprendre leurs besoins et leur présenter les solutions SumUp les plus adaptées
  • Réaliser des démonstrations claires et convaincantes de nos produits
  • Négocier et conclure vos ventes directement sur le terrain
  • Gérer l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact jusqu'à la signature
  • Développer durablement votre secteur grâce à une prospection régulière et structurée
  • Suivre vos résultats et ajuster votre approche pour atteindre et dépasser vos objectifs

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Une formation complète et régulière à nos produits et à nos méthodes de vente
  • Un accompagnement de proximité pour développer rapidement vos compétences commerciales
  • Une grande autonomie dans l'organisation et le développement de votre secteur
  • Un environnement dynamique, international et orienté vers la performance
  • Une opportunité de rejoindre le secteur de la tech et de la fintech
  • Des perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions commerciales seniors ou d'encadrement

Ce poste est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez déjà une expérience concrète de la prospection à froid, idéalement sur le terrain
  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour aborder des prospects qui ne connaissent pas encore SumUp et susciter leur intérêt
  • Vous aimez la vente terrain, la prospection directe et le contact humain
  • Vous savez créer rapidement une relation de confiance
  • Vous faites preuve d'aisance orale, d'énergie et de force de conviction
  • Vous savez rebondir face aux objections et rester motivé(e) dans un environnement exigeant
  • Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e), persévérant(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats
  • Vous aimez les objectifs ambitieux et souhaitez avoir un impact direct sur votre rémunération
  • Vous parlez couramment français et disposez d'un niveau d'anglais vous permettant de participer à des échanges internes

Une expérience préalable en prospection à froid est indispensable pour réussir dans ce poste.

Vos avantages

En complément de votre rémunération, vous bénéficiez notamment de :

  • 25 jours de congés payés, auxquels s'ajoutent les jours fériés et des jours de congé spéciaux offerts par SumUp (anniversaire, déménagement...)
  • Break4Me : un mois de congé sabbatique entièrement rémunéré après trois ans d'ancienneté
  • Titres-restaurant de 12 € par jour travaillé
  • Une solution de mobilité adaptée à votre situation : allocation mobilité/véhicule de 400 € via Betterway remboursement à 100 % de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou budget de mobilité douce de 600 € par an
  • Indemnité téléphonique de 30 €
  • Indemnité Internet de 36 €
  • Mutuelle d'entreprise
  • Accès à Wellpass, avec une participation de SumUp, pour vos activités sportives et de bien-être
  • Accès à notre plateforme CE d'avantages salariés
  • Consultations médicales à distance gratuites avec Livi
  • Accès aux services de La Maison Bleue
  • Accompagnement proposé par Action Logement
  • Programme de recommandation interne
  • Des opportunités régulières de formation, d'apprentissage et de développement professionnel

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange avec un recruteur – Discussion sur votre parcours et vos motivations
  2. Entretien avec le manager – Approfondissement de vos compétences et de votre compréhension du rôle
  3. Mise en situation commerciale – Exercice pratique permettant d'évaluer votre approche de la vente terrain

À propos de SumUp

Chez SumUp, nous soutenons les commerçants du quotidien : artisans, restaurateurs, indépendants et commerces de proximité. Nos solutions leur permettent d'accepter facilement les paiements, de gérer leur activité et de se concentrer sur ce qu'ils font de mieux.

Plus de 3 000 collaborateurs issus de 93 nationalités contribuent aujourd'hui à cette mission. Guidés par nos valeurs — Founder's Mentality, Team First et We Care — nous travaillons ensemble pour simplifier le quotidien des petites entreprises.

SumUp est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des profils.

Un dernier conseil

Vous avez une expérience en prospection à froid, mais ne cochez pas tous les autres critères ? Postulez quand même.

Votre potentiel, votre motivation, votre capacité à apprendre et votre envie de réussir peuvent faire toute la différence.

Prêt(e) à transformer chaque rencontre en opportunité et à développer votre secteur avec SumUp ? Postulez dès maintenant et venez construire la suite de votre réussite commerciale avec nous.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

In this Software Engineer role, you will play an important part in the development of a market-leading, open standards first platform, providing flexible, modular and scalable identification, authentication, and authorization to a range of applications. You will be part of a team that prides itself on an open, flexible environment, embracing collaboration, agile methodologies, continuous improvement, and most of all, the love of a challenge. 

We require a passionate developer who flourishes in a fast-moving, agile environment. You must have good communications skills, an outstanding ability to translate requirements and designs to functional Java code, and a strong attention to security, quality, testability and performance.

You Will

  • Work as part of an agile development team to implement the highest quality product features
  • Use AI tooling as a practical part of the engineering workflow to accelerate discovery and delivery
  • Have a voice in working with product management and owners to improve the platform and develop new features for our platform
  • Understand and improve our local and cloud deployments
  • Plan and estimate work to be completed
  • Maintain existing code and resolve reported defects
  • Actively contribute to the culture that makes this such a great team

You Have

  • Strong familiarity with the Java programming language
  • Possess the desire to learn and curiosity to understand how and why things work
  • Demonstrate strong collaboration, communication, and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills
  • Ideal candidate must be keen to learn quickly and independently, and be capable of gathering information and understanding complex features and environments
  • Ability to use AI engineering tools to accelerate research, code understanding, prototyping, implementation, and documentation while applying sound engineering judgment

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Familiarity with UI development, using javascript, and the Vue or React frameworks 
  • Experience with development tools, including IDEs, Git, Jenkins, and Maven, Bazel
  • Solid understanding of RESTful web services
  • Experience with identity management technologies and protocols (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, certificate & key management, cryptography, etc.)
  • Understanding of enterprise-scale systems and configurations related to security
  • Solid grounding in modern software engineering practices and design patterns, including the design and implementation of modern web applications

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone's individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Als Senior Java Fullstack Developer (m/w/d) gestaltest du leistungsfähige Anwendungen, vom Backend mit Java und Spring bis zum Frontend mit React. Dabei bringst du deine Expertise in die Entwicklung, automatisierte Bereitstellung und Qualitätssicherung der Software ein.

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Backend-Komponenten auf Basis von Java/Java EE und Spring

  • Umsetzung moderner Benutzeroberflächen mit React und JavaScript/TypeScript

  • Implementierung von Datenbankzugriffen und Anbindung relationaler Datenbanken wie Oracle oder PostgreSQL

  • KnowHow mit relationalen Datenbanken wie Oracle oder PostgreSQL sowie mit Applikationsservern wie JBoss von Vorteil

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau sowie Englisch auf Konversationsniveau

  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Terminen bei einem Remote-Anteil von etwa 80 %

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Entwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) - Remote, 4-Tage-Woche
jobs.description:
Intro

Du möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert? Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig!

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.

  • Ownership für die Umsetzung: Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Projekt von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live ankommt. Aufgaben schneiden und priorisieren, Fortschritt im Blick behalten, technische Entscheidungen treffen und Blocker aus dem Weg räumen.

  • Anleitung & Wissenstransfer: Fachliche Führung weiterer Entwickler im Projekt durch klare technische Vorgaben, Pairing und Code Reviews im Backend wie im Frontend. Wissen über Architektur und Entscheidungen landet im Team und in der Dokumentation, nicht nur bei dir.

  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.

  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.

  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.


Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.

  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.

  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.

  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.

  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.

  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.


Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)

  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)

  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen

  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)


Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.

  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.

  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.

  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.


Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

  • 4 Tage Code – 3 Tage du selbst: Bei uns ist die 4-Tage-Woche Standard. Kein Gimmick, sondern Realität. Du arbeitest remote oder im Leipziger Büro – so, wie du am besten performst. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an.

  • Dein Stack, dein Style: Wir stehen auf smarte Lösungen, sauberen Code und Menschen, die mitdenken. Du willst mitentscheiden, ausprobieren und nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten? Here you go. Plus: Mentoring, Weiterbildung nach Bedarf und Raum für echte Weiterentwicklung.

  • Remote first, Team always: Trotz Remote bleibt das Teamgefühl. Wir feiern Releases, grillen im Sommer und stoßen auf tolle Ideen an. Dein Bürohund ist bei uns genauso willkommen wie dein Lieblingseditor.

  • Professionalität: echte Qualität statt Show-off. Wir leben agile Entwicklung mit klaren Iterationen und direktem Feedback. Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.

  • Snacks, Swag & Softdrinks: Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Wasser – alles for free. Kein Dresscode. Komm, wie du bist. Hauptsache du fühlst dich wohl.

  • Perks, die was bringen: Kita-Zuschuss, Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge, Leipziger Jobticket oder sportliche Angebote für deinen Ausgleich – vom Homegym bis zum Fitnessstudio für Kopf und Körper.


Dein Weg zu uns

Keine Lust auf lange Anschreiben? Kein Problem! Erzähl uns einfach kurz, warum du Teil vom Händlerbund werden möchtest und warum wir gut zu dir passen. Nutze dazu die Möglichkeit dich online über unser Bewerbungsformular zu bewerben.

  • Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Produktspezifikationen in tragfähige technische Lösungen übersetzen und zentrale Architekturentscheidungen treffen.
  • Hands-on Software entwickeln: Produktive Software selbst bauen – vom Frontend über Backend und Datenhaltung bis zu Schnittstellen und Betrieb.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast einen belastbaren Track Record mit produktiv eingesetzter Software.

jobs.title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Agora Industry

Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.


Your responsibilities include

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
  • Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
  • Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
  • Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
  • Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
  • Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
  • Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
  • Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
  • Actively contributing to internal discussions.
  • Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
  • As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
  • As Project Manager, the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.


We are looking for

  • A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
  • As Project Officer: Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
  • As Project Manager: At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass
  • A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. 
  • Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors.
  • Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. 
  • Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus.
  • Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. 
  • Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus.
  • Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers.
  • A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact.
  • Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents.
  • Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel outside Europe. 

 We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job.


What we offer

  • An opportunity to work in a mission-driven, highly motivated, and professional international team.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement; including access to a mental well-being platform.
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid work environment, with access to an attractive office space in central Berlin and a good setup to work from home.
  • Weekly breakfast, team events and other get-togethers with colleagues from around the globe.
  • One option from our benefit basket (e.g. job ticket, shopping vouchers, Urban Sports, etc.).
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development and advancement.
  • Entitlement of 29 paid leave days per year (5-days working week); 24th & 31st December off-work.
  • A cooperative working atmosphere with flat communication and decision-making hierarchies.
  • Assistance with visa and work permits for international candidates if required.
  • A structured onboarding programme and regular team and organisation-wide retreats to bring us all together; and 
  • A full or part-time role, initially limited to two years.


How to apply

We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why
 you are the right person for the job.
We look forward to receiving your application by 30th of September 2026 via our website.
For reasons of objectivity, we ask that you refrain from submitting an application
 photo.
We want an energy transition for everyone from everyone. Therefore, we are particularly
 pleased to receive applications from people from groups that have been underrepresented
 in energy and industrial policy. We welcome applications regardless of gender and gender identity,
 nationality, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability and age, and sexual orientation. Our
 offices are not completely barrier-free, but we are open to find individual solutions.
  As part of this, we are soliciting anonymous information on a voluntary basis regarding
 our applicant’s background. This information will be used only to inform future
 recruitment strategies and will not impact hiring decisions in any form. Your input will
 not be forwarded to third parties and will not be used in connection with your application.

jobs.description:
📍 London - Hybrid. 2 days per week in our London office, 3 days remote / work from home (40 hour week)
🚆 Monthly travel to one of our other offices (Sheffield/Lincoln) is essential.
✴ All travel and accommodation costs to non-base office locations are fully covered.

We've spent the last three years transforming how our People Team operates. Now we're looking for someone to own the machine and work out what comes next!

About the role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to own the operating layer of our People function, managing our People Operations Specialist and reporting directly to our People Director.

This isn't a traditional HR Operations role, and we're not looking for someone to simply keep existing processes running. We want someone who's curious about how and why things work - someone who spots friction, interrogates the data, challenges the way we've always done things and builds something better.

You'll own our People operations, systems and data across the end-to-end colleague lifecycle - from onboarding, offboarding and Right to Work through to colleague requests, payroll processes, benefits and compliance. You'll make sure the fundamentals run brilliantly while continuously looking for ways to simplify, automate and improve them.

Data is a big part of this role. We need someone who's genuinely at home in the numbers - happy getting into a complex spreadsheet, reconciling different data sources, spotting inconsistencies and using data to understand what's happening rather than simply reporting what it says.

You'll also take significant ownership of our reward infrastructure, including quarterly pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

And increasingly, you'll help us answer a bigger question: what work should technology be doing for us?

We're already exploring how AI and automation can remove repetitive work across People Operations. You don't need to arrive as an AI expert, but you do need to be curious, willing to experiment and excited about what technology could make better.

If you get a kick out of taking something that already works, understanding it properly and making it simpler, smarter and better, we'd love to hear from you.

Who are you?

You're probably someone who sees People Operations a little differently.

You care about delivering a brilliant colleague experience, but you're just as interested in the systems, data and processes underneath it. Numbers don't scare you - quite the opposite.

You don't accept a seven-step process because it's always had seven steps. You want to understand why it's there, whether we still need it and what would happen if we did it differently.

In practice:

  • You're naturally curious, analytical and highly numerate, with advanced Excel skills and the confidence to work independently with complex data.

  • You love improving how things work and have redesigned and implemented processes, rather than simply inherited and administered them.

  • You're comfortable getting into the detail while still seeing the bigger picture - whether that's interrogating a spreadsheet, configuring a workflow or digging into an HRIS.

  • You're pragmatic, comfortable with ambiguity and good at bringing people with you when something needs to change.

What we need from you

  • Significant People Operations experience, with ownership of end-to-end People processes.

  • Hands-on experience owning or significantly shaping People systems and data, including an HRIS (we use Personio, but we're open to others!) and/or headcount planning systems.

  • Strong numerical reasoning and advanced Excel skills - you're comfortable reconciling data, spotting anomalies and turning numbers into useful insight.

  • Experience across reward and benefits, ideally including pay reviews, salary benchmarking and banding, benefits and gender pay gap reporting.

  • A track record of continuous improvement and using systems, data and technology to make People Operations better.

  • An active interest in AI and automation and how they can change the way People teams operate.

  • Confidence working across People Partnering, Talent, Finance, Payroll and Tech in a fast-moving environment.

It would also be great if you have:

  • Experience in a high-growth, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing AI/agentic workflows that are being used in practice.

  • A background in accountancy, audit, management consulting or another analytically rigorous environment that has given you strong foundations in numerical reasoning, process, controls or data.

And one thing you won't need?

A particular HR qualification. We care much more about what you've actually built, improved and owned than whether you have CIPD after your name.

Our mission:

  • Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Our mission? To provide them with the best renting experience in the world 🌎

  • We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution 🏠

  • Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,500 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 300+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission! 💚

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

jobs.title: Senior Research Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

LOCATION: London (Monday-Thursday in the office, Friday remote) 
CONTRACT: Full-time
SALARY: £36,000-£46,000 
START DATE: As soon as possible

More in Common is a research agency working across the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and Poland to tackle polarisation and division. More in Common leads and supports initiatives to build more united, inclusive, and resilient societies. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. 
 
In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. More in Common are members of the British Polling Council. 
 
Our work is informed by our ground-breaking segmentation of the British public. This unique values-based lens to our quantitative and qualitative research means we can understand not only what the public thinks of the big challenges facing British society today – but crucially why they think it. Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues. 
 
Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. Our work is regularly covered in the British press and media and we’ve developed a series of partnerships with broadcasters and newspapers to deliver top-quality research insights. In the 2024 General Election, we were among Britain’s most accurate pollsters and used our focus group research to put people and public opinion at the centre of coverage of the election campaign.
 
Through our consultancy, More in Common has also supported dozens of partners with insights and strategic communications support. We’ve helped national institutions such as the BBC, British Library and National Trust to better understand their audiences, we’ve helped partners in government and civil society with the set-up and delivery of the Homes for Ukraine scheme, and we’ve supported a range of partners to test their policy proposals from the National Farmers Union to Rethink Mental Illness among many others.
 
More in Common has a range of exciting projects in the pipeline, including: 

  • Understanding the key dynamics of public attitudes to climate change and the energy transition.
  • Exploring public opinion on immigration, integration and multiculturalism.
  • Embedding our new Seven Segments with a wider range of organisations, including developing new products and trainings to help people understand the segments.
  • Helping navigate declining trust in institutions, for example exploring why trust in universities and science appears to be falling.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

More in Common is seeking a Senior Research Associate to deliver high-quality research projects. They will work across our core areas of research for clients, media and communications, political polling and partnerships. More in Common UK is a small team with a start-up culture where everyone is expected to execute a range of responsibilities. The role will be based in our London office Monday-Thursday with Friday at the office or working at home. 
 
Research

  • Deliver public opinion research projects using quantitative and qualitative methods
  • Regularly conduct polling and focus groups for clients
  • Provide excellent client management and ensure all outputs for clients are high-quality  
  • Craft research findings into clear, compelling reports and decks that provide actionable insights for clients
  • Contribute to the development of More in Common's research agenda, identifying gaps and opportunities for new projects
  • Cultivate and secure exciting new research projects for More in Common by building relationships with and reaching out proactively to potential partners
Comms and External Engagement
  • Represent More in Common in external settings including media appearances, roundtables, events and conferences
  • Communicate research findings to diverse audiences including policymakers, civil society, and the media
  • Build and maintain relationships with research partners, academic institutions, and partner organisations 
Supervision
  • Support the development of research associates and assistants, providing day-to-day guidance, feedback, and structured professional development
  • Support a hard-working, intellectually-curious and fun team culture, modelling More in Common's values internally and externally


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

We look for great people before we look for specific qualifications and experience - so we are open to applications from candidates with great potential but limited experience. 
 
For this role, some experience in professional research or political setting is a plus. This might be in a research agency, think tank, comms or PR firm or other policy, public opinion or political organisation. The role is less suitable for someone whose primary experience is academia.
 
The key elements we’re looking for are:

  • Some professional experience in a research, polling, policy or political context
  • Excellent writing skills and some experience in producing a range of high-quality written outputs (such as reports, op-eds or briefings) for a variety of audiences
  • Some experience interpreting quantitative and qualitative data and producing outputs that tell a compelling story from this data.
  • A strong understanding of the UK political system and a keen interest in current affairs and public policy
  • The aptitude and desire to work in a fast-paced environment, delivering high-quality outputs for clients
  • Curiosity for understanding and engaging people, and a desire to use data to tell insightful stories about Britain today  
We understand that not everyone with the skillset for this role will have all of the above – that is fine. We are most interested in your intellect, aptitude and experience to date, and your willingness to throw yourself into tackling some of the biggest issues in understanding the forces driving British society apart.


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We will have a better chance of uniting divided societies if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political opinions, and life experiences. We particularly encourage applications from underrepresented and minority communities
 
More in Common wants to meet the aims and commitments set out in our equality policy. This includes not discriminating under the Equality Act 2010. We will include a set of questions related to this in our email acknowledging your application for this role - this will help us understand the diversity of our job applicants.  Answering these questions are completely voluntary and anonymous. The information provided will be kept confidential and will not be linked to your application. The information is going to be used to help us understand the diversity of our organisation.


DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY

The application deadline is Sunday 20 September 23:59.
 
Applications should include a CV and a short cover letter (max. two pages). jobs.title: Senior Business Intelligence Lead (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 

  • Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform.
  • Agree on definitions, data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them.
  • Maintain and verify the certified data layer, built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it.
  • Use SQL to validate data, investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources.
  • Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning.
  • Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree.
  • Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully.
 
What this role is not 
You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. 



What you bring along

Must-have 

  • Senior experience in BI, analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful.
  • Strong SQL skills.You can read and write SQL,validate data, and trace where a number comes from.
  • Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners.
  • Experience with data models, data quality, or data governance.
  • A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers.
  • A hands-on, business-minded approach. You connect business questions with practical data solutions.
  • Experience with automation, AI Agents, or AI-supported workflows.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus.
Nice to have 
  • Experience with Metabase, dbt, AWS Glue, Spark, Airbyte, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, EV charging, energy, mobility, or a related field.
You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL, sound data thinking, and the ability to bring people to one shared definition.


What you can expect from us

How we work 
Clear goals, real ownership, and little politics. We move quickly, decide together, and hold each other accountable.
 
Where you will work 
Our Munich office at Stiglmaierplatz is an important place for collaboration. For this role, we expect at least three days on-site each week. 

What you get 

  • 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest.
  • Mental health, taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive.
  • AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down.
  • Move sustainably - JobRad, subsidised public transport, or EGYM Wellpass. You choose what fits your life.
  • €1,000 learning budget -Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow.
  • Your future, sorted - Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO. Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fineprint.

MotorK. Driving the AI revolution in automotive.

MotorK is Europe's leading sales and marketing technology company for the automotive sector. We build AI-powered tools: from CRM and inventory management to predictive analytics and digital advertising, that help manufacturers and dealerships sell smarter and deliver better customer experiences. 90% of European automotive manufacturers run on our SparK Platform, alongside 6,000+ dealerships across the continent.

We move fast, we think big, and AI is at the core of everything we do, not as a buzzword, but as the engine behind every product decision we make. We're building a team of people who are genuinely curious about AI, who experiment with it, push it, and find new ways to use it to solve real problems.

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success team to be based in our Antwerp office. This role would require a relocation to Belgium. 

The Role

The Customer Success Manager role will cover a wide range of account management, onboarding, and client growth tasks, as it liaises with the Delivery, Sales, and Product teams. The Customer Success Manager will:

  • Serve as the primary reference point for clients throughout their entire lifecycle with MotorK, taking full account management ownership.
  • Own the customer onboarding journey from contract signature to successful product go-live, ensuring product activation aligns with the dealer’s digital strategy and signed SLA.
  • Conduct structured onboarding sessions, translate client requirements into clear delivery briefs, and manage cross-functional execution.
  • Drive adoption, prevent churn, and execute upselling/cross-selling activities to meet individual and team revenue goals.
  • Provide ongoing digital marketing, lead generation, and lead management expertise using the DealerK Method.
  • Track and report on key account metrics, including NPS, retention, time-to-go-live, and product adoption rates.

Requirements

Our ideal Customer Success Manager will have previous experience in Sales, Account Management, or Customer Success (ideally within a SaaS or digital product environment) and digital marketing strategy knowledge.

As well as:

  • Previous experience in account management or customer success, with a strong plus for end-to-end customer onboarding ownership.
  • Deep understanding of the B2B automotive dealer sector and web technologies (CMS, SEO concepts) or SaaS industry.
  • Project management mindset with proven ability to bridge business requirements and technical delivery teams.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Native Flemish speaker, fluency in French and English.
  • A proactive, goal-oriented approach with a passion for digital technologies and automotive innovation.

Work Pattern and Location

  • Permanent contract, full time
  • Monday – Friday
  • Hybrid role with occasional field trips 
  • Location: Antwerp

Benefits

  • Salary range: 40k-50k depending on experience
  • Commission plan: between 10 and 20% of fixed salary
  • Relocation support package
  • Meal Vouchers (for each day worked) 8€

  • Hospitalisation Insurance 
  • Mobile phone and SIM

  • Modern centrally located office, with gym onsite 
  • Internal training paths and support with external education
  • Diverse and dynamic environment, with plenty of opportunity to grow and make an impact 
  • Company benefits including discounts on famous brands

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.

jobs.description:
Build the infrastructure powering the future of construction

At XYZ Reality, we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our technology, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to help construction teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, the infrastructure behind our technology needs to scale with us.

We’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to take ownership of the cloud infrastructure and DevOps practices powering our BIM Platform, working across Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, security and developer tooling.

The Role

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with broad ownership across our cloud and platform infrastructure.

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Data and Security teams to build reliable, scalable infrastructure while improving how our developers deploy, monitor and troubleshoot their services.

We want DevOps to be an enabler rather than a gatekeeper. That means building the tooling, automation and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to move quickly and safely without creating unnecessary dependencies on DevOps.

You’ll have the autonomy to identify where our infrastructure and engineering practices can improve and take ownership of making those improvements happen.

The role is based in our London office on a hybrid basis, with 3 days per week in the office.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Architect, maintain and evolve our Microsoft Azure infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters

  • Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, ARM templates and Helm

  • Design and improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, enabling fast, safe and repeatable deployments

  • Build observability across our infrastructure and services through monitoring, logging, alerting and distributed tracing

  • Improve platform reliability, scalability and performance through capacity planning, autoscaling and resource optimisation

  • Build and maintain disaster recovery, backup and failover strategies

  • Strengthen infrastructure security across areas including network policies, secrets management and platform hardening

  • Establish and improve incident response processes, on-call practices, runbooks and blameless post-mortems

  • Work with our Data team to support reliable and scalable PostgreSQL and MongoDB environments

  • Build self-service tooling, templates and documentation that reduce unnecessary reliance on DevOps

  • Support infrastructure for data pipelines and AI/ML model deployment as our technology continues to evolve

  • Partner directly with developers on deployment, troubleshooting and infrastructure best practices.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a strong, hands-on DevOps Engineer who is comfortable owning complex infrastructure and operating across a broad technical environment.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Demonstrable in-depth experience in DevOps, Infrastructure or Cloud Engineering

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure

  • Deep experience with Kubernetes, including cluster design, networking, storage, upgrades and troubleshooting

  • Strong Infrastructure-as-Code experience using Terraform, ARM templates or equivalent

  • Experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions

  • Strong experience with containers and Docker

  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting and observability within production environments

  • Good knowledge of infrastructure security, including network segmentation, encryption, secrets management and audit logging

  • Experience building automation and tooling using Python, Go, Bash or TypeScript

  • Strong troubleshooting skills and experience taking ownership of production infrastructure and incidents

  • The ability to make pragmatic technical decisions and clearly explain infrastructure trade-offs.

Strong AWS or GCP experience could also be relevant where you can demonstrate the ability to transfer that knowledge into an Azure environment.

Experience with high-availability infrastructure, PostgreSQL or MongoDB, AI/ML infrastructure, ETL/data pipelines, FinOps or SOC 2/ISO 27001 environments would be a bonus.

Above all, we’re looking for someone who enjoys automating away problems rather than repeatedly solving them manually. You’ll be comfortable taking ownership, challenging processes that don’t scale and building the tools and practices that make the wider engineering team more effective.

Why Join Us

  • 🚀 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

  • 🏠 Hybrid working from our London office

  • 🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

  • 🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

  • 🎄 Additional Christmas shutdown days

  • 🪙 Biannual salary reviews

  • 🥳 Summer & Christmas company events

  • 🍣 Free Thursday lunch and after-work gatherings

  • 💰 Employee referral scheme

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 🌍 Make a real-world impact revolutionising the construction industry

If you’re a Senior DevOps Engineer who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex infrastructure challenges and building environments that enable engineering teams to move faster, we’d love to hear from you.

If you'd like to see the products and technology we have created so far on our journey you can view it in action through our YouTube and Website

jobs.title: Strategic Client Manager
jobs.description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients are hugely important to Flock: they have more vehicles, more data and more opportunity to benefit from everything our connected proposition can offer, and we want to give them an even better experience as we grow. We’re looking for a Strategic Client Manager to become the primary face of Flock for our largest customers, owning the relationship and making sure they get the very best from us.

Nearly all of our business comes through brokers, and that remains central to how we work: you’ll sit at the heart of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business to deliver a brilliant joined-up service. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution, and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts, manage client queries and improve reporting, freeing up more time for relationships and problem-solving.

You’ll have the opportunity to build our corporate client management approach from the ground up: shaping account reviews and performance reporting, bringing together claims, safety, underwriting and finance for our biggest clients, and taking real ownership when something needs to get done. Success is simple: our clients stay with us, get more value from Flock and recommend us to others.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the relationship with a portfolio of Flock’s largest fleet clients, becoming their primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their business.

  • Build and run our corporate account management approach: client reviews, reporting, relationship cadence and account planning.

  • Work closely with brokers and our Broker Development Managers to deliver a coordinated experience for every client.

  • Bring together teams across Flock, including claims, safety, underwriting and finance, to resolve client questions and issues quickly, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organisations.

  • Identify retention risks early and create clear plans to protect our most important accounts.

  • Support the commercial management of the smaller number of corporate clients that work with Flock directly.

  • Help shape and improve Flock’s wider client service proposition, including account reviews, portal engagement, safety support, claims and reporting, feeding client feedback back into the business.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting.

 

What you’ll need

  • Strong experience within the insurance industry, with a clear understanding of the broker–client–insurer dynamic and the judgement to know where you add value, without duplicating the broker’s role, creating confusion or adding unnecessary layers for the client.

  • Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position.

  • A proven track record of managing important client relationships and delivering strong retention or customer satisfaction, with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders across clients, brokers and internal teams.

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can identify when an account is at risk, understand what matters to the client and build a plan to retain them.

  • The ability to work effectively within a broker-led relationship, knowing when to lead, when to support the broker and when to bring in specialist colleagues.

  • Energy and ownership: comfortable picking up a problem and driving it through to a solution, and confident using AI in your daily work to work faster and deliver a better client experience.

  • Preferable: experience with large, complex or multi-site corporate clients, Commercial Motor Fleet or fleet risk and safety experience, or exposure to the claims process or to building an account management or client service proposition.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

jobs.title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About us

UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.
Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.

At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.


Your mission

You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.


Your profile

  • You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.
  • You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).
  • You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.
  • You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.
  • You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.

How we work
We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.

Potential Research Directions
These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.
1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.
2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.
3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.

Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own.


What we offer

  • Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors.
  • Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events.
  • Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship.
  • Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.
  • Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.
  • AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.
  • Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.

Interested?
Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!


Diversity is important to us

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.
